## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A schema-validated openspec/owners.yaml resolves an owner set for any...

The system SHALL ensure that a schema-validated openspec/owners.yaml resolves an owner set for any capability, roadmap item, or contract path, falling back to a declared repository-default owner.

#### Scenario: A schema-validated openspec/owners.yaml resolves an owner set for any...

WHEN `ownership-map` is implemented
THEN A schema-validated openspec/owners.yaml resolves an owner set for any capability, roadmap item, or contract path, falling back to a declared repository-default owner.

### Requirement: A check reports capabilities with no owner and owners that are not...

The system SHALL ensure that a check reports capabilities with no owner and owners that are not registered principals in the extended principal registry (no separate registry is created).

#### Scenario: A check reports capabilities with no owner and owners that are not...

WHEN `ownership-map` is implemented
THEN A check reports capabilities with no owner and owners that are not registered principals in the extended principal registry (no separate registry is created).

### Requirement: With no owners.yaml present, every resolver call returns the sole repository...

The system SHALL ensure that with no owners.yaml present, every resolver call returns the sole repository principal and the existing skill test suites pass unchanged (solo mode).

#### Scenario: With no owners.yaml present, every resolver call returns the sole repository...

WHEN `ownership-map` is implemented
THEN With no owners.yaml present, every resolver call returns the sole repository principal and the existing skill test suites pass unchanged (solo mode).

### Requirement: The resolver works from the git checkout alone with the coordinator...

The system SHALL ensure that the resolver works from the git checkout alone with the coordinator unavailable, and CODEOWNERS generated from owners.yaml produces no routing disagreements in a reconcile check.

#### Scenario: The resolver works from the git checkout alone with the coordinator...

WHEN `ownership-map` is implemented
THEN The resolver works from the git checkout alone with the coordinator unavailable, and CODEOWNERS generated from owners.yaml produces no routing disagreements in a reconcile check.

### Requirement: owners.yaml is registered in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md with writer,...

The system SHALL ensure that owners.yaml is registered in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md with writer, authority, and missing/stale behavior.

#### Scenario: owners.yaml is registered in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md with writer,...

WHEN `ownership-map` is implemented
THEN owners.yaml is registered in docs/guides/state-artifacts.md with writer, authority, and missing/stale behavior.
